_readme: A4 data source. Mark updates this monthly (later: generated from the Eventbrite API by a1_registration_report.py's successor). Dates must be REAL scheduled cohorts — the module hides anything in the past automatically. 'register' must be the DIRECT Eventbrite/Corsizio listing URL, never an intermediate page. Course pages in ad campaigns are FROZEN — this module goes only on the pillar page, the two quiz results screens, and the About page.
